questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'स्थावर' शब्द का विलोम शब्द क्या है? / What is the antonym of 'Sthavar'?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'स्थावर' (स्थिर रहने वाला) का सही विलोम शब्द 'जंगम' (चलने-फिरने वाला) होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'कविश्रेष्ठ' (कवियों में श्रेष्ठ) में कौन सा तत्पुरुष समास है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'कवियों में श्रेष्ठ' (सप्तमी/अधिकरण कारक का चिह्न 'में') होने से इसमें अधिकरण तत्पुरुष है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'सूर्योदय' (सूर्य + उदय) शब्द में कौन सी सन्धि है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'अ + उ = ओ' (आद्गुणः सूत्र) होने के कारण इसमें गुण स्वर सन्धि है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'अन्वेषण' (अनु + एषण) में कौन सी सन्धि है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'उ' का 'व्' (इको यणचि) में परिवर्तन यण सन्धि का उदाहरण है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'जो मापा न जा सके' वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. जिसे मापा न जा सके उसे 'अपरिमेय' कहा जाता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'अंगूठा दिखाना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'अंगूठा दिखाना' का अर्थ एन मौके पर किसी काम से साफ इनकार कर देना है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध शब्द का चयन कीजिए:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'कवि' का सही स्त्रीलिंग एवं शुद्ध वर्तनी 'कवयित्री' है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'चौपाई' छंद के प्रत्येक चरण में कितनी मात्राएं होती हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. चौपाई एक सममात्रिक छंद है जिसके प्रत्येक चरण में 16-16 मात्राएं होती हैं।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'शांत रस' का स्थायी भाव क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. शांत रस का स्थायी भाव 'निर्वेद' या शम होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'अनुराग' का सही विलोम शब्द क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'अनुराग' का विलोम शब्द 'विराग' होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Select the correct SYNONYM of 'OBSTREPEROUS':
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'Obstreperous' means noisy and difficult to control; unruly.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Select the correct ANTONYM of 'GREGARIOUS':
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'Gregarious' means fond of company; its opposite is 'reclusive'.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Identify the error: 'No sooner did the bell rang than the students ran out.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. After auxiliary verb 'did', base form of verb ('ring' instead of 'rang') must be used.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Transform into Passive Voice: 'Who wrote this famous play?'
options: By whom was this famous play written?
By whom had this famous play been written?
Who was written this famous play by?
By whom is this famous play written?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'Who + past verb' converts to 'By whom + was + subject + past participle'.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Convert into Indirect Speech: The teacher said, 'Light travels in a straight line.'
options: The teacher said that light travels in a straight line.
The teacher said that light traveled in a straight line.
The teacher told light travels in a straight line.
The teacher said that light had traveled in a straight line.
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Universal truths and scientific facts remain in Simple Present in indirect speech.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Fill in the blank: 'He is averse ________ taking unnecessary physical risks.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. The adjective 'averse' takes the preposition 'to'.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] What does the idiom 'To throw down the gauntlet' mean?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'To throw down the gauntlet' means to issue a challenge.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] One-word substitution: 'A disease or condition that persists for a long time.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. A 'chronic' condition persists over a long period or constantly recurs.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Identify the figure of speech: 'The wild winds weep in the dark night.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Attributing human emotions (weeping) to non-human entities (winds) is Personification.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Select the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. The correct spelling is 'Surveillance'.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'इचुयशानाम् ________' सूत्र के अनुसार उच्चारण स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'इचुयशानां तालु' सूत्र से इ, च-वर्ग, य और श का उच्चारण स्थान तालु होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'आद्गुणः' सूत्र से किस सन्धि का विधान होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. अ/आ के पश्चात् इ/उ/ऋ आने पर गुण एकादेश (ए, ओ, अर्) होना गुण सन्धि है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'महाभाष्य' ग्रन्थ के रचयिता कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. अष्टाध्यायी पर विस्तृत महाभाष्य की रचना पतंजलि ने की थी।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'उपकृष्णम्' (कृष्णस्य समीपम्) में कौन सा समास है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. पूर्व पद 'उप' अव्यय होने के कारण 'उपकृष्णम्' में अव्ययीभाव समास है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'सहयुक्तेऽप्रधान' सूत्र के योग में कौन सी विभक्ति होती है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'सह, साकम्, सार्धम्' के योग में अप्रधान कर्त्ता में तृतीया विभक्ति होती है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'पठितुम्' पद में कौन सा प्रत्यय है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. पठ् + तुमुन् = पठितुम् (पढ़ने के लिए)।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] संस्कृत में स्पर्श व्यंजनों की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'कादयो मावसानाः स्पर्शाः' - क से म तक कुल 25 स्पर्श व्यंजन हैं।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'हरि' शब्द का पंचमी विभक्ति एकवचन रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. इकारान्त 'हरि' शब्द का पंचमी व षष्ठी एकवचन रूप 'हरेः' होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] संस्कृत संख्या 'एकोनचत्वारिंशत्' का क्या अर्थ है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. एक उन (कम) चत्वारिंशत् (40) = 39.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'रघुवंशम्' महाकाव्य के रचयिता कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 19 सर्गों वाले 'रघुवंशम्' महाकाव्य के रचयिता महाकवि कालिदास हैं।

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who is the current Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)? / भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) के वर्तमान गवर्नर कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Sanjay Malhotra succeeded Shaktikanta Das as the RBI Governor.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] India's first deep ocean human mission MATSYA 6000 is named: / भारत के गहरे समुद्र के मानव मिशन का नाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Samudrayaan project employs the MATSYA 6000 submersible to explore deep ocean resources.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] What is the name of the female humanoid robot built by ISRO for Gaganyaan test flights? / गगनयान के परीक्षण हेतु इसरो द्वारा बनाई गई महिला रोबोट का नाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Vyommitra is a half-humanoid robot designed by ISRO.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who won the Nobel Prize in Literature 2024? / 2024 का साहित्य का नोबेल पुरस्कार किसे मिला?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. South Korean author Han Kang won the Nobel Prize in Literature 2024.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who won the Best Actor award at the 70th National Film Awards for 'Kantara'? / 70वें राष्ट्रीय फिल्म पुरस्कारों में फिल्म 'कांतारा' हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता का पुरस्कार किसने जीता?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Rishab Shetty won Best Actor for his role in 'Kantara'.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Where is the headquarters of ISRO located? / इसरो (ISRO) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. ISRO headquarters is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which city in UP is famous as the 'Perfume Capital of India' (इत्र नगरी)? / उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन सा शहर 'इत्र नगरी' के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Kannauj is renowned for its traditional perfume (attar) industry.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which city in UP is known as 'Peetal Nagari' (Brass City)? / उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर को 'पीतल नगरी' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Moradabad is world-famous for its brass handicrafts.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] What is the State Tree of Uttar Pradesh? / उत्तर प्रदेश का आधिकारिक राज्य वृक्ष कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ashoka (Saraca asoca) is the official state tree of UP.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which Article of the Constitution guarantees Right to Education (RTE)? / कौन सा अनुच्छेद शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) प्रदान करता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Article 21A inserted by 86th Amendment 2002 makes free primary education a Fundamental Right.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which Constitutional Amendment introduced Panchayati Raj in India? / भारत में पंचायती राज व्यवस्था किस संशोधन द्वारा लागू हुई?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992 added Part IX and 11th Schedule for Panchayats.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who is the Ex-Officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha? / राज्यसभा का पदेन सभापति कौन होता है?
options: Vice President of India / भारत का उपराष्ट्रपति
Speaker of Lok Sabha / लोकसभा अध्यक्ष
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. The Vice President of India presides as the Ex-Officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] What is the minimum age required to become a Lok Sabha MP? / लोकसभा सदस्य बनने हेतु न्यूनतम आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Minimum age for Lok Sabha is 25 years (30 for Rajya Sabha).

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in 1828? / 1828 में 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
options: Raja Ram Mohan Roy / राजा राममोहन राय
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Raja Ram Mohan Roy established Brahmo Samaj in Kolkata.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] First Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between Babur and: / 1526 में पानीपत की पहली लड़ाई बाबर और किसके बीच हुई थी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in 1526 laying the Mughal Empire foundation.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who gave the slogan 'Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it'? / 'स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है' का नारा किसने दिया?
options: Bal Gangadhar Tilak / बाल गंगाधर तिलक
Lala Lajpat Rai / लाला लाजपत राय
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak gave this historic slogan.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Ozone layer is located in which layer of the atmosphere? / ओजोन परत वायुमंडल की किस परत में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ozone layer is situated in the Stratosphere.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Where is WHO (World Health Organization) headquarters located? / डब्ल्यूएचओ (WHO) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. WHO headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] International Yoga Day is celebrated every year on: / अंतर्राष्ट्रीय योग दिवस प्रतिवर्ष कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. International Yoga Day is celebrated on June 21.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'? / किस नदी को 'बिहार का शोक' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Kosi River is called Sorrow of Bihar due to frequent flooding.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which pass connects Srinagar to Leh? / श्रीनगर को लेह से जोड़ने वाला दर्रा कौन सा है?
options: Zoji La Pass / ज़ोजी ला दर्रा
Nathu La Pass / नाथू ला दर्रा
Shipki La Pass / शिपकी ला दर्रा
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Zoji La Pass connects Srinagar with Leh in Ladakh.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Radcliffe Line forms the boundary between India and: / रेडक्लिफ रेखा भारत और किस देश के मध्य सीमा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Radcliffe Line separates India and Pakistan.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who authored the book 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'? / 'पोवर्टी एंड अन-ब्रिटिश रूल इन इंडिया' पुस्तक किसने लिखी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Dadabhai Naoroji (Grand Old Man of India) authored this book on drain of wealth.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which bank is known as the 'Banker's Bank' in India? / भारत में 'बैंकों का बैंक' किसे कहा जाता है?
options: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) / भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक
State Bank of India (SBI) / भारतीय स्टेट बैंक
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RBI is the central bank and regulates all commercial banks in India.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which state in India has the highest area under forest cover? / क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत के किस राज्य में सर्वाधिक वन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. MP has the largest forest cover by total geographical area.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If 20% of a number is 80, what is 50% of that number? / यदि किसी संख्या का 20% मान 80 है, तो उसका 50% मान क्या होगा?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Average of first 10 prime numbers is: / प्रथम 10 अभाज्य संख्याओं का औसत क्या होगा?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Simple Interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is: / ₹5,000 पर 8% वार्षिक दर से 3 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज कितना होगा?
[Section 3: Mathematics] A trader sells a watch for ₹720 with a profit of 20%. The cost price is: / 20% लाभ पर ₹720 में बेची गई घड़ी का क्रय मूल्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. CP = SP / (1 + Profit%) = 720 / 1.20 = ₹600.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] HCF of 36 and 84 is: / 36 और 84 का म०स० (HCF) क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 36 = 12 * 3, 84 = 12 * 7. Highest Common Factor = 12.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 8 cm is: / आधार 12 सेमी और ऊंचाई 8 सेमी वाले त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Area = 1/2 * base * height = 1/2 * 12 * 8 = 48 sq cm.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] A train 150m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Speed of train in km/h is: / 150 मीटर लंबी ट्रेन खंभे को 9 सेकंड में पार करती है। ट्रेन की चाल किमी/घंटा में क्या होगी?

[Section 3: Mathematics] A and B can do a work in 10 and 15 days respectively. Together they will finish it in: / A और B किसी काम को क्रमशः 10 और 15 दिन में पूरा करते हैं। दोनों मिलकर इसे कितने दिन में करेंगे?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Combined time = (10 * 15) / (10 + 15) = 150 / 25 = 6 days.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If side of a cube is 5 cm, its Total Surface Area is: / यदि घन की भुजा 5 सेमी है, तो कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Total Surface Area of cube = 6 * a^2 = 6 * 5^2 = 6 * 25 = 150 sq cm.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If x - 1/x = 3, then x^2 + 1/x^2 is: / यदि x - 1/x = 3 है, तो x^2 + 1/x^2 का मान क्या होगा?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Exterior angle of a regular octagon (8 sides) is: / समअष्टभुज (8 भुजाओं) के एक बाह्य कोण का मान क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Exterior angle = 360° / n = 360° / 8 = 45°.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If circumference of a circle is 44 cm, its radius is: (π = 22/7) / यदि वृत्त की परिधि 44 सेमी है, तो उसकी त्रिज्या क्या होगी?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Mode of the given data set: 4, 5, 6, 5, 7, 5, 8, 9, 5, 6 is: / आंकड़ों 4, 5, 6, 5, 7, 5, 8, 9, 5, 6 का बहुलक (Mode) क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Mode is the value appearing most frequently. 5 appears 4 times.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Complementary angle of 42° is: / 42° कोण का कोटिपूरक कोण क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Complementary sum = 90°. Required angle = 90° - 42° = 48°.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Simplify: (1/2 + 1/3) ÷ (1/4) / व्यंजक (1/2 + 1/3) ÷ (1/4) को सरल करें:
[Section 3: Mathematics] Convert 0.454545... into a simple fraction: / 0.454545... आवर्ती दशमलव को भिन्न में बदलें:
[Section 4: Science] Device used to measure electric current in a circuit is: / परिपथ में विद्युत धारा मापने वाला यंत्र है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ammeter is connected in series to measure electric current.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Mirage in deserts is caused by: / मरुस्थल में मरीचिका (Mirage) किस घटना के कारण बनती है?
options: Total Internal Reflection / पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Mirage occurs due to total internal reflection of light.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] What is the normal human body temperature in Celsius? / मानव शरीर का सामान्य तापमान सेल्सियस में कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Normal body temperature is 37 °C (98.6 °F).

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Which acid is present in ant sting? / चींटी के डंक में कौन सा अम्ल होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ant sting contains Formic acid (Methanoic acid).

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Organelle known as the 'Powerhouse of the cell' is: / 'कोशिका का पावरहाउस' किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Mitochondria generates ATP energy for cellular function.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Metal present in Chlorophyll pigment is: / क्लोरोफिल वर्णक में कौन सी धातु होती है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Chlorophyll contains Magnesium at its central core.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Hormone responsible for regulating blood sugar levels is: / रक्त शर्करा नियंत्रित करने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Insulin secreted by Pancreas lowers blood glucose levels.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Tissue responsible for water transport in plants is: / पौधों में जल संवहन के लिए कौन सा ऊतक उत्तरदायी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Xylem transports water and minerals from roots to leaves.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Longest river in India is: / भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ganga is India's longest river (2,525 km).

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Kaziranga National Park in Assam is famous for: / काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
options: One-horned Rhinoceros / एक सींग वाला गैंडा
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Kaziranga NP hosts the world's largest population of great one-horned rhinos.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states? / कर्क रेखा भारत के कितने राज्यों से गुजरती है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian states.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Fundamental Concept of 'Ecosystem' was proposed by: / 'पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र' (Ecosystem) शब्द सर्वप्रथम किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. A.G. Tansley introduced the term 'Ecosystem' in 1935.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Which Fundamental Right was removed by the 44th Amendment Act 1978? / 44वें संशोधन द्वारा किस मौलिक अधिकार को हटाया गया?
options: Right to Property / संपत्ति का अधिकार
Right to Education / शिक्षा का अधिकार
Right to Freedom / स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार
Right to Equality / समानता का अधिकार
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Right to Property was made a legal right under Article 300A.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Only floating national park in the world (Keibul Lamjao) is in: / विश्व का एकमात्र तैरता राष्ट्रीय उद्यान कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Keibul Lamjao NP on Loktak Lake in Manipur is the only floating park.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Which district of UP is famous for Glassware and Bangles? / उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन सा शहर कांच की चूड़ियों हेतु प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Firozabad is known as the glass city of India.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Project Tiger was launched in India in which year? / भारत में 'प्रोजेक्ट टाइगर' किस वर्ष शुरू किया गया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Project Tiger was launched in April 1973 from Jim Corbett NP.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] First step of micro-teaching cycle is: / सूक्ष्म शिक्षण चक्र का प्रथम पद क्या होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Micro-teaching cycle begins with Planning (पाठ नियोजन).

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] TLM used to teach visually impaired students is: / दृष्टिबाधित बालकों हेतु उपयुक्त TLM है:
options: Braille Script & Tactile Materials / ब्रेल लिपि व स्पर्शनीय सामग्री
Charts and Posters / चार्ट व पोस्टर
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Braille script and tactile models serve visually impaired learners.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] 'Learning by Doing' principle is emphasized by: / 'करके सीखना' (Learning by Doing) सिद्धांत पर कौन सा दर्शन बल देता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Pragmatism (John Dewey) advocates experiential learning by doing.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Main objective of Diagnostic Teaching (निदानात्मक शिक्षण) is: / निदानात्मक शिक्षण का मुख्य उद्देश्य है:
options: To identify learning weaknesses & causes / अधिगम कठिनाइयों एवं कारणों की पहचान
To conduct annual exam / परीक्षा लेना
To punish weak students / दंड देना
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Diagnostic teaching identifies student learning gaps before remediation.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Remedial Teaching (उपचारात्मक शिक्षण) follows: / उपचारात्मक शिक्षण किसके बाद किया जाता है?
options: Diagnostic Evaluation / निदानात्मक परीक्षण के बाद
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Remedial instruction remedies gaps discovered during diagnostic evaluation.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Bloom's Taxonomy of Educational Objectives classifies domain into: / ब्लूम के वर्गीकरण के 3 पक्ष कौन से हैं?
options: Cognitive, Affective, Psychomotor / ज्ञानात्मक, भावात्मक, मनोक्रियात्मक
Mental, Physical, Social / मानसिक, शारीरिक, सामाजिक
Reading, Writing, Speaking / पठन, लेखन, वाचन
Knowledge, Memory, Logic / ज्ञान, स्मृति, तर्क
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Benjamin Bloom classified educational objectives into Cognitive, Affective, and Psychomotor domains.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Questioning skill in classroom is best used to: / कक्षा में प्रश्नोत्तर तकनीक का सर्वोत्तम उपयोग है:
options: Arouse curiosity & active engagement / उत्सुकता जगाना व सक्रिय सहभागिता
Test memory only / केवल रटना जांचना
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Questioning stimulates critical thinking and active student engagement.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Programmed Instruction method was developed by: / 'अभिक्रमित अनुदेशन' (Programmed Instruction) के प्रतिपादक हैं:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. B.F. Skinner developed Linear Programmed Instruction based on Operant Conditioning.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Operant Conditioning theory of learning was propounded by: / 'क्रिया प्रसूत अनुबंधन सिद्धांत' किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. B.F. Skinner experimented on rats/pigeons to demonstrate Operant Conditioning.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Insight Theory of Learning (सूझ का सिद्धांत) was demonstrated using chimpanzee 'Sultan' by: / चिम्पैंजी 'सुल्तान' पर प्रयोग कर सूझ का सिद्धांत किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Gestalt psychologist Wolfgang Kohler demonstrated Insight Learning.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Primary Laws of Learning given by Thorndike are: / थार्नडाइक द्वारा दिए गए सीखने के 3 मुख्य नियम हैं:
options: Law of Readiness, Exercise, Effect / तत्परता, अभ्यास, प्रभाव का नियम
Law of Primacy, Recency, Frequency / नवीनता, पुनरावृत्ति नियम
Law of Intensity, Association, Duration / तीव्रता, साहचर्य नियम
Law of Reward, Punishment, Fear / पुरस्कार व दंड नियम
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Thorndike formulated 3 primary laws: Readiness, Exercise, and Effect.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] First psychological laboratory was established in Leipzig (1879) by: / 1879 में प्रथम मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रयोगशाला की स्थापना किसने की थी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Wilhelm Wundt established the first psychology laboratory in Leipzig, Germany.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] 'Father of Behaviorism' in psychology is: / मनोविज्ञान में 'व्यवहारवाद के जनक' किसे कहा जाता है?
options: John B. Watson / जॉन बी. वाटसन
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. J.B. Watson established Behaviorism in 1913.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] According to Piaget, 'Concrete Operational Stage' spans between ages: / पियाजे अनुसार 'मूर्त-संक्रियात्मक अवस्था' की आयु सीमा है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Concrete operational stage lasts from 7 to 11 years.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Scaffolding concept in learning was highlighted by: / अधिगम में 'पाड़/ढांचा' (Scaffolding) की संकल्पना किससे संबंधित है?
options: Lev Vygotsky & Bruner / वाइगोत्स्की एवं ब्रूनर
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Scaffolding is temporary support provided by MKO (More Knowledgeable Other) in ZPD.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Personality classification into Introvert, Extrovert, Ambivert was given by: / अंतर्मुखी, बहिर्मुखी, उभयमुखी व्यक्तित्व वर्गीकरण किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Carl Jung classified personality types into Introvert, Extrovert, and Ambivert.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Right to Education Act 2009 came into force in India on: / भारत में RTE अधिनियम 2009 किस तिथि से लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RTE Act 2009 came into national effect on April 1, 2010.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] According to NCF 2005, main purpose of assessment is: / NCF 2005 अनुसार आकलन का मुख्य उद्देश्य है:
options: To improve teaching-learning process / शिक्षण-अधिगम प्रक्रिया में सुधार
To pass or fail students / पास-फेल घोषित करना
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Assessment serves as feedback to enhance learning outcomes.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Leadership style where leader consults team before deciding is: / लोकतांत्रिक/परामर्शदायी नेतृत्व शैली कहलाती है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Democratic leadership involves group participation and consensus.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Important life skill needed for resolving conflict constructively is: / द्वंद्व/संघर्ष समाधान हेतु आवश्यक जीवन कौशल है:
options: Effective Communication & Empathy / प्रभावी संचार व सहानुभूति
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. WHO lists effective communication and interpersonal empathy as core life skills.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Main purpose of Providing Mid-Day Meal in schools is: / मध्याह्न भोजन योजना (Mid-Day Meal) का मुख्य उद्देश्य है:
options: To increase enrollment, retention & nutrition / नामांकन, ठहराव व पोषण सुधार
To reduce teacher workload / शिक्षक का काम घटाना
To provide employment to cooks / रसोइयों को काम देना
To replace home food / घर का खाना बदलना
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Mid-Day Meal Scheme enhances school attendance and addresses child hunger.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Punishment that harms child's body or dignity is called: / बालक को शारीरिक/मानसिक क्षति पहुंचाने वाला दंड कहलाता है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RTE Act Section 17 strictly bans Corporal Punishment in educational institutions.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Ability to understand and manage one's own emotions is: / स्वयं के संवेगों को समझने व नियंत्रित करने की क्षमता कहलाती है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Self-regulation is a crucial component of Emotional Intelligence.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Formative Assessment (रचनात्मक आकलन) is conducted: / रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन कब किया जाता है?
options: During the instruction process / शिक्षण-अधिगम प्रक्रिया के दौरान
At the end of the academic year / सत्र के अंत में
Before starting the school / प्रवेश के समय
Only during board exams / बोर्ड परीक्षा में
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Formative assessment provides continuous ongoing feedback during learning.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] Select the word least like the others in group: / समूह से भिन्न शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Dog is an adult animal; Cub, Kitten, and Puppy are young offspring.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] If 'CLOCK' is coded as '34235' and 'TIME' as '8679', how is 'MOLE' coded? / यदि 'CLOCK' = '34235', 'TIME' = '8679', तो 'MOLE' = ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Direct letter coding: M=7, O=2, L=4, E=9 -> 7249.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] A is B's brother. C is A's mother. D is C's father. How is B related to D? / A, B का भाई है। C, A की मां है। D, C का पिता है। B का D से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. D is maternal grandfather to A and B. Thus B is Grandson or Granddaughter to D.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] What was the day of week on 15th August 1947? / 15 अगस्त 1947 को सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Standard calendar calculation confirms Aug 15, 1947 was a Friday.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] Complete the series: 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, ? / श्रृंखला पूरी करें: 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Pattern: +2, +4, +8, +16, +32. Next term = 33 + 32 = 65.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] Primary non-volatile permanent memory in a computer is: / कंप्यूटर की प्राथमिक स्थायी (Non-volatile) मेमोरी है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. ROM (Read Only Memory) retains data permanently even when unpowered.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] HTML stands for in web design: / वेब डिज़ाइन में HTML का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
options: HyperText Markup Language / हाइपरटेक्स्ट मार्कअप लैंग्वेज
HighTech Markup Language / हाईटेक मार्कअप लैंग्वेज
HyperText Memory Link / हाइपरटेक्स्ट मेमोरी लिंक
HyperLink Text Language / हाइपरलिंक टेक्स्ट लैंग्वेज
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. HTML = HyperText Markup Language.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] Which open source operating system is widely used in servers and smartphones (Android)? / एंड्रॉइड में प्रयुक्त ओपन-सोर्स ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Android OS is built on top of the open-source Linux kernel.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] Digital platform launched by Ministry of Education for teacher training & school resources is: / शिक्षकों हेतु शिक्षा मंत्रालय का डिजिटल मंच है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. DIKSHA is the national digital platform for school education and teacher training.
